result.hw_emu_rootfs_mount_block_reason: Linux kernel panic at boot: 'VFS: Unable to mount root fs on unknown-block(179,2)'. Block 179 = MMC major, partition 2 = root partition. The sd_card.img has 2 ext4 partitions (file output confirms: 'partition 1 active...partition 2 ID=0x83'). Kernel cmdline expects /dev/mmcblk0p2 but qemu sd-card model with -boot mode=5 (sd1) presents the disk as mmcblk1; switching to mode=3 (sd0) did NOT resolve — kernel still panics with unknown-block(179,2). This is a Vitis 2024.1 + custom-PetaLinux interop issue: the platform's u-boot/kernel cmdline assumes the original Vitis-platform rootfs layout, not the PetaLinux-overridden one.
result.host_elf_executed_block_reason: host.elf cannot run without rootfs mount completing. The userspace login prompt never appears in hw_emu.
